evaluation_target.rationale: The safety goal explicitly requires prevention of omitted braking maneuvers, and the hazard describes the harmful outcome when braking is not performed in time to avoid collision.

phenomenon_of_interest.statement: The vehicle's braking-relevant operational state in obstacle/collision-avoidance situations, including whether a required braking maneuver is initiated and whether the vehicle can stop in time to avoid collision.
phenomenon_of_interest.scope: Straight-ahead driving situations on the referenced road context in which obstacles or road users may require braking to avoid collision, as described by the hazard and braking-related functional requirements.
phenomenon_of_interest.rationale: Evaluation of the safety goal depends on the operational situation where braking may be required to avoid collision, not on the internal implementation of sensing, fusion, planning, or control.

distinctions.contrast_a: A required braking maneuver is initiated
distinctions.contrast_b: A required braking maneuver is omitted
distinctions.rationale: The safety goal and hazard distinguish between successful braking initiation and omission; collapsing these would remove the core information needed to evaluate whether the concern occurs.

distinctions.contrast_a: The vehicle stops in time to avoid collision with the road user or static obstacle
distinctions.contrast_b: The vehicle does not stop in time and collides with the road user or static obstacle
distinctions.rationale: The hazardous event is defined by whether stopping occurs in time to avoid collision; collapsing these states would remove information needed to evaluate the safety concern.

distinctions.dimension: Obstacle detection sufficiency for braking decision
distinctions.contrast_a: An obstacle is detected in time for braking to be started within the timing requirement
distinctions.contrast_b: An obstacle is not detected in time, or is not detected as an obstacle, so braking cannot be started in time
distinctions.rationale: The timing and obstacle-detection requirements indicate that whether detection occurs in time affects whether braking can be evaluated as required; collapsing timely versus untimely detection would remove information relevant to judging the braking concern.

orrs.obligation: An admissible Observable Representation shall preserve whether a required braking maneuver was initiated versus omitted.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: It must be possible to distinguish representations corresponding to braking initiation from representations corresponding to braking omission.

orrs.obligation: An admissible Observable Representation shall preserve whether the vehicle stopped in time to avoid collision versus failed to stop in time and collided.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: It must be possible to distinguish representations of collision-avoidance success from representations of collision due to insufficient stopping in time.

orrs.obligation: An admissible Observable Representation shall preserve whether obstacle detection occurred in time for braking to be started within the required time window versus not in time.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: It must be possible to distinguish timely obstacle detection from untimely or absent obstacle detection insofar as this affects braking initiation.

assumptions.statement: The obstacle detection timing requirement and dangerous-zone notion are applicable to the concern context.

revalidation_conditions.condition: If the braking timing requirement or the dangerous-zone definition is revised or replaced.
